verdicts.reason: A is basically the original shrunk to fit. Every element survives in order (bottle, headline, NEW pill, Try It), but the headline and the NEW pill are very small at 320x50 and the spacing between elements is uneven, so it needs polish. B makes the headline and CTA bigger, but the NEW badge is crushed into a tiny broken sliver under the headline. The headline also runs right up against the bottle circle and is jammed close to the Try It button, which leaves no breathing room and loses a brand element.
